title: Is the F2.9 t+1/t+2 race a timing window after an extreme bar, or just clustered S1 bars?

why_this_and_not_zone_residual.f29_audit: OPEN_REGIME_WINDOW is the clean result. OPEN_ZONE_RESIDUAL barely clears zero (ci95_lower=+0.0015, MDE=0.034) and must not drive aVol x BigTrap2. S1 beats K0 on P_mode. Use the cheap OHLC stamp, not the kernel, as the default trigger.
why_this_and_not_zone_residual.object: a 1-2 minute window after an extreme bar, still target-free

question: After an S1 bar, does P_mode on the next bar remain special even when that next bar is not itself S1? If the effect lives only when t+1 is also S1, it was clustering, not a window.

population.stamp: S1 = range_ticks>=3 and max(upper_wick_frac,lower_wick_frac)>=0.30 and volume>=session median
population.probe: P_mode d=2 width=1 on the evaluated bar, not on the stamp bar

arms.selects: bar b where b-1 is S1, same session
T1_all and b is not S1
S1 and previous bar is not S1

B_placebo_next_bar.selects: bar b where b-1 is a non-S1 matched to an S1 on session, range quintile, close_loc quintile, volume quintile, nearest in time
B_placebo_next_bar.question: Is any next minute special, or only the minute after S1?

arms.selects: bar b where b-1 created a BigTrap2 zone

C_kernel_needed.contrast: T1_after_K0 minus T1_after_S1, paired by session

D_t2_and_tm1.note: t-1 negative in F2.9 is reported, not promoted, unless it beats its own placebo and ci95_upper<0.

decision_rules.OPEN_POST_STAMP_WINDOW: T1_not_S1 ci95_lower>0 and (T1_not_S1 minus P1) ci95_lower>0, with support
decision_rules.OPEN_CLUSTER_ONLY: T1_and_S1 ci95_lower>0 and T1_not_S1 compatible with zero
decision_rules.OPEN_PRE_STAMP_REVERSAL: T_minus1 ci95_upper<0 and (T_minus1 minus placebo_minus1) ci95_upper<0
decision_rules.primary_if_multiple: OPEN_POST_STAMP_WINDOW over OPEN_CLUSTER_ONLY; do not open aVol or zone residual from this run
